Enable Flight Path Vectors HUD.tooltip: Enables markers that indicate the flight path of the ship

Markers Size.tooltip: Set the size of the navigation markers in the ship

Auto Rotation Sensibility.tooltip: How hard the ship will try to align to a selected rotation

Artificial Horizon.tooltip: The Artificial horizon is a line parallel to a planet horizon

Enable Rate of Closure HUD.tooltip: Enables an indicator showing how quick your ship is approaching a target

Enable Surface Speed HUD.tooltip: Enables an indicator showing how fast your ship is going parallel to the surface of the target

Enable True Speed HUD.tooltip: Enables an indicator showing how fast your ship is travelling toward the prograde indicator

Enable Acceleration HUD.tooltip: Enables an indicator showing how much the ship acceleration changes

Enable Orbit Speed HUD.tooltip: Enables an indicator showing the required speed to orbit the target

Acceleration Units.tooltip: In which units to show the ship acceleration

Enable Trajectory Console (broken).tooltip: Enables an (currently broken) console that would have allowed the ship to rotate to set directions
